---
title: "wrapped"
subtitle: "Wrap body text around figures in Quarto"
toc: false
---

wrapped is a Quarto filter extension. It lets body text flow beside a
figure, to the left or right of it. The figure keeps its number, its
caption, and its `@fig-` links.

::: demo
![Mean ratings by condition.](images/ratings.png){#fig-home .wrap-right width="40%"}

This paragraph sits beside @fig-home. The figure has the class
`.wrap-right`, so it goes to the right side of the text column, and the
paragraphs after it flow on its left.

One markdown syntax gives this layout in HTML, in PDF through LaTeX, in
PDF through Typst, and in Word. Wrapping stops at the next block that is
not a paragraph, such as a heading or a list.

In a window 576px wide or narrower, the figure stops floating and takes
the full width of the text column.
:::

This version wraps figures in HTML output, revealjs slides and dashboards
included, in PDF through LaTeX, in PDF through Typst, and in Word. In
every other format, a wrapped figure renders as a normal figure, and the
render prints one warning.

## Install

The extension asks for Quarto 1.9.36 or later, and it is tested with Quarto
1.10.19. In the folder of your project, run:

```bash
quarto add jmgirard/wrapped
```

Then add the filter to the document's YAML header:

```yaml
filters:
  - wrapped
```

[Get started](get-started.qmd) shows each kind of figure that wraps. The
[examples](examples/index.qmd) show each one rendered in HTML, in PDF
through LaTeX, in PDF through Typst, and in Word.
